observation_profile.name: operator_source_review_of_stopped_draft
observation_profile.operation: Read-only inspection of retained source and prior capability evidence; no extension execution or fresh provider-environment capability probe.

table18_row.publication_rule: Mark Table 18 required world/procedure consumption untested/out of scope and remove required-mode extension claims. Do not block the planned core evaluation (context, routing, translation, fixture lifecycle, restart publication).

shadow_write.definition: Compute sidecar artifacts without changing authority or making those artifacts part of task completion.

shadow_read.definition: Evaluate hypothetical decisions from world/program state without influencing behavior or changing authority.

guarded.definition: Bounded consumption under independent checks; separately approved from shadow modes.

required.definition: Each eligible task consumes a verified pre-root, current obligations and route/context decision, then publishes observations, validation, accepted/rejected transition, and completion/post-root evidence.

candidates.paper_claim: ProcedureCegis already implements a bounded synthesis state machine (PDF p. 5, §5.3).

nearby_non_substitutes.name: FormalAssuranceCegis
nearby_non_substitutes.disposition: Separately named bounded repair CEGIS. NS-002 forbids substituting it for ProcedureCegis. Certificates do not grant write authority; LLMs cannot promote patches.

nearby_non_substitutes.name: ProgramRepairSynthesizer
nearby_non_substitutes.disposition: Proposal-only repair synthesis over reviewed operators. Not ProcedureCegis; no write, semantic, or proof authority.

candidates.paper_claim: Incoming memory mines independently admitted trajectories, preserves failed episodes, infers applicability, and validates anti-unified procedures on held-out families (PDF p. 5, §5.3).

nearby_non_substitutes.name: deterministic_failure_memory
nearby_non_substitutes.disposition: Append-only deterministic repair failure memory. Not the incoming-memory method, not anti-unification, and not held-out procedure validation.

candidates.paper_claim: Learned call-target, event-delta, inverse-trace, and repair-delta models rank constrained candidates or abstain; predicted transitions become accepted state only after observation or verification (PDF p. 5, §5.3; pp. 15–16, §D.5).

nearby_non_substitutes.name: ir_learning_campaign_planner
nearby_non_substitutes.disposition: Deterministic campaign adapter. It never grants a lease while RESULT identities are unresolved and never attaches proof results to a candidate projection.

candidates.paper_limit: The broader SCC/partition/CST/remodularization program remains separately tracked against the author's local worktree (PDF p. 17, §E.4).

source_present_non_consumption.name: SupervisorWorldView
source_present_non_consumption.disposition: Mutation-free query over one verified snapshot. Immutability is enforced. Querying a snapshot is not required-mode pre/post consumption.

source_present_non_consumption.name: WorldSnapshotBuilder
source_present_non_consumption.disposition: Independently verified authority admission for a schedulable snapshot. Optional DuckLake projection never grants scheduling authority. Admission is not observed required-mode consumption.

optional_closed_here: ProcedureCegis / incoming memory / learned world models

required_for_reopening: An exact located implementation whose identifier matches the retained claim, not a nearby similarly scoped module.
A distinct frozen learned artifact when the claim is learned; otherwise the PGIR-014 no-go remains.
Held-out family/time splits frozen before training/synthesis, with final acceptance outputs hidden from those stages.
Static, history, lexical, embedding, and template controls; negative memory of failed applicability.
Independent validation and rollback, with applicability failures, abstentions, bad predictions, and rollback costs remaining visible.
Guarded or required consumption distinguished from shadow-write/shadow-read; no worker self-promotion or protected-validator edits.
Paired pre-state consumption and accepted post-state evidence on the held-out bounded profile, measuring downstream repair/usefulness rather than sidecar logging.
claim_boundary: This is a source-and-capability qualification. No extension is retained. It records no consumed world/procedure result, no learned-model evaluation, no remodularization benefit, and no required-mode self-hosting demonstration.

current_source_inventory.method: Read-only file hashes and bounded Python-source identifier search; not module execution.
